title: STRETCH AND BALANCE
subtitle: SUNDAY SOFTNESS. LENGTHEN KIND. STEADY FEET.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Sunday is stretch and balance — a soft little break from the chair. About ten minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft stretch, steady balance, and you showed up. Enjoy your Sunday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward toward the floor or shins only as far as feels kind. Soft neck. Pause a soft breath at the end, then come back up with control. A smaller reach is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach for a soft stretch. Two sets of five. Soft belly, hinge gently and reach forward only as far as feels kind. Soft neck. Pause a soft breath, then come up. Smaller reach is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Light hand weights optional — empty hands are fine. Reach the arms gently forward, then draw the elbows back as if squeezing a soft cushion between the shoulder blades. Soft neck, easy breath. Smaller pull is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row for soft posture. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, reach gently forward, then draw the elbows back. Empty hands are fine. Smaller pull is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the shoulders. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Lift one knee a little toward the ceiling, then set it down gently. Alternate sides with an easy rhythm. Soft hands on the seat edges if you like. Smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts for easy hip stretch and mobility. Two sets of eight each leg. Soft belly, lift one knee a little, set it down gently. Easy rhythm. Smaller lift is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the hips. Easy breath.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside a sturdy chair, light fingertips on the backrest for support. Soft belly. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other foot just a little — a toe tap is plenty. Soft knee on the standing leg. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch sides. Use more hand support any time; smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance. Two sets of about twenty seconds each side. Light fingertips on the chair, soft belly, lift one foot just a little. Soft knee. More support is always fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the standing leg. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session — lovely work.
